title: Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2611.30142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing

translated_title: 在行人重识别重排序中分离协议效应与时空证据
translated_abstract: 时空先验利用相机对和时间间隔对行人重识别的匹配结果进行重排序，据报告在Market-1501数据集上能带来显著收益。我们探究这类收益中有多少是在编码评估协议本身，而非真正学到的时空证据。我们从一个将“对数相机转换项”和“对数时间间隔项”加到余弦相似度上的课程项目式重排序器出发，训练了一个强大的ResNet-50基线（三个随机种子下Rank-1为94.3%，mAP为86.2%），在不相交身份的验证集上选择融合权重，并使用对照先验在官方测试集上进行评估。该仓库形式的先验增加了2.30个mAP点，但仅对同相机对施加一个单参数惩罚就能增加2.19个点：由于评估协议从不把真实匹配放在与查询相同的相机中，该惩罚无需付出任何代价即可排除干扰项。该形式的时间项几乎未被利用；成对级别的诊断将其归因于该模型在给定匹配条件下对时间间隔建模时没有进行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现时空先验重排序在Market-1501上的大部分收益源于评估协议的偏差（真实匹配从不与查询出现在同一相机），而非学到的时空证据——仅一个针对同相机对的单参数惩罚就能带来与完整先验几乎相同的提升。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that most of the reported gains from spatio-temporal re-ranking on Market-1501 stem from evaluation protocol bias—true matches never share the query's camera—rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence, as a simple one-parameter same-camera penalty alone nearly matches the full prior's improvement.
